p1.title: Find your next favorite book
p1.body: Browse a warm collection of stories, novels and poems.

p2.title: Read anywhere
p2.body: Take your whole library with you, wherever you like to read.

p3.title: Cozy up and read
p3.body: Pick a book, make a cup of tea and enjoy the next page.

b1.title: The Maze Runner
b1.author: James Dashner
b1.description: A boy wakes up with no memory in a place surrounded by a deadly maze, and must find a way out together with the others.

b2.title: The Chronicles of Narnia
b2.author: C. S. Lewis
b2.description: Children step through a wardrobe into a magical land of talking animals, where it is always winter.

b3.title: Little Women
b3.author: Louisa May Alcott
b3.description: Four sisters grow up together, chase their dreams and lean on each other through good times and hard ones.

b4.title: Anne of Green Gables
b4.author: L. M. Montgomery
b4.description: A talkative, imaginative orphan girl arrives at a farm and slowly wins over a whole village.

b5.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's stone
b5.author: J. K. Rowling
b5.description: A boy discovers he is a wizard and begins a magical adventure at a school of witchcraft and wizardry.

b6.title: Ikadoli
b6.author: Dr. Hanan Lashin
b6.description: A fantasy adventure: a young man opens an empty book and is carried to a strange land, where he gains unusual abilities and fights to save the kingdoms.

b7.title: The Book Thief
b7.author: Markus Zusak
b7.description: A young girl in Nazi Germany finds comfort in stealing books, in a story told by Death himself.

b8.title: The Hunger Games
b8.author: Suzanne Collins
b8.description: In a harsh future nation, a girl volunteers to take her sister's place in a televised fight for survival.
